nodes.procedure: A piece of NF (2×3 cm²) was washed with 3 M HCl, ethanol, and deionized water several times to ensure the surface of the NF was well cleaned before use.

nodes.name: Hydrothermal NiSe Growth on NF
nodes.procedure: The freshly prepared NaHSe solution was added to 30 mL ethanol under N2 flow. Then the solution was transferred into a 50 mL Teflon-lined stainless steel autoclave with a piece of pretreated NF maintained at 140°C for 12 h in an electric oven. After the autoclave cooled down slowly at room temperature, the sample was collected and washed with water and ethanol several times and then dried at 60°C for 4 h. The mass of NiSe catalyst on NF was calculated as NiSe_loading = x mg × (M_NiSe / M_Se) = x mg × (138 / 79) = 1.747x mg, where x is the weight increment of NF.

nodes.characterization_summary: HRTEM shows interplanar distances of 2.85 Å and 3.01 Å corresponding to (300) and (101) planes of NiSe.
nodes.evidence_snippet: High-resolution TEM (HRTEM) with the results shown in Fig. 1f, the interplanar distances of 2.85 and 3.01Å can be identified as (300) and (101) planes of NiSe (Fig. 1f), respectively.

nodes.characterization_summary: SAED pattern displays discrete spots corresponding to the (300), (021) planes of NiSe.
nodes.evidence_snippet: The selected-area electron-diffraction (SAED) pattern (Fig. 1g) displays discrete spots corresponding to the (300), (021) planes of the NiSe.

nodes.characterization_summary: HAADF-STEM and EDX mapping reveal uniform distribution of Se and Ni elements.
nodes.evidence_snippet: The HAADF-TEM and EDS mapping images further reveal the uniform distribution of Se and Ni (Fig. 1h-j).

nodes.characterization_summary: EDX elemental mapping shows uniform distribution of Ni and Se. After SOR, Ni and Se elements still exist.
nodes.evidence_snippet: Energy dispersive spectroscopy (EDS) mapping were conducted ... The HAADF-TEM and EDS mapping images further reveal the uniform distribution of Se and Ni (Fig. 1h-j). ... it still can be clearly seen that the existence of Ni, Se elements in NiSe/NF after SOR (Fig. S9f).

nodes.characterization_summary: XPS offers the valence state of NiSe. After reaction, Ni 2p XPS rules out formation of oxyhydroxide or oxide species.
nodes.evidence_snippet: X-ray photoelectron spectroscopy (XPS) in Fig. S2 offers the valence state of NiSe. ... The Ni 2p XPS analysis after reaction rules out the formation of oxyhydroxide or oxide species on NiSe surface...

nodes.characterization_summary: FT k³-weighted EXAFS spectra show peak at 2.08 Å assigned to Ni-Se scattering path.
nodes.evidence_snippet: Meanwhile, in the Fourier-transformed (FT) k³-weighted extended X-ray absorption fine structure (EXAFS) spectra (Fig. S3), the peak at about 2.08Å is assigned to the Ni-Se scattering path.

nodes.characterization_summary: CVs at various scan rates used to calculate double-layer capacitance Cdl of 10.89 mF/cm² for ECSA estimation.
nodes.evidence_snippet: To estimate the ECSA, CVs were collected at various scan rates... The capacitance of NiSe/NF and NF is 10.89 mFcm⁻² and 0.27 mFcm⁻², respectively, indicating NiSe/NF further steers the kinetics of SOR by producing more catalytic active sites.
